metadata.notes: Worker deduplicates the WAHA message ID, stores the incoming message, immediately processes STOP/UNSUBSCRIBE/CANCEL/OPTOUT, and returns autoReply=true only for a known contact when AI replies are enabled.

filter.name: Known contact and AI replies enabled

mapper.systemPrompt:
{{concat(2.data.instructions; "

SAFETY RULES: Reply only to the latest incoming message. Be concise, courteous, and factual as At The Agency. Do not send marketing or initiate a conversation. Do not request passwords, payment details, or sensitive personal data. Do not claim to have booked, sent, changed, or verified anything. If uncertain, say a team member will follow up. Return only the reply text.")}}

metadata.notes: Select a Make AI Provider connection and a low-cost fast model. AI is opt-in per workspace from Dashboard > Settings > AI auto-reply.
Send only after the Worker confirms this is not an opt-out and AI auto-reply is enabled. Keep the WAHA endpoint private behind an authenticated HTTPS tunnel.
Persist the reply in the incoming message inbox. WAHA HTTP acceptance is not a delivery or read receipt.

notes: After import create a Custom Webhook, configure WAHA's default session `message` webhook event to target it, then replace YOUR-DEPLOYED-DOMAIN, YOUR-WAHA-HOST, WAHA_API_KEY, and WHATSAPP_AUTOMATION_SECRET values in the HTTP modules. Keep the WAHA API key and automation secret in protected Make connections/secret fields.

Incoming event payloads are normalized by the Worker. It stores a message once, suppresses STOP, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, and OPTOUT immediately, and returns no AI permission for unknown contacts or when the workspace toggle is off.

Make receives no API authorization to send arbitrary messages: it sends one generated response only after a Worker-approved, non-opt-out incoming message. Never add promotional campaigns to this flow.

Configure WAHA with API-key authentication and use an HTTPS tunnel or cloud-hosted API reachable from Make. The Windows localhost address is not reachable from Make. WAHA is unofficial and carries account restriction risk; prefer the official WhatsApp Business Platform for production.
